snippet.title: Black Dawn (1996) PS1 - Gameplay HD
snippet.description:
Black Dawn is a helicopter-combat simulation, published by Virgin Interactive Entertainment. It was released on the Sony PlayStation in 1996, and the Sega Saturn in 1997.

Initial release date: 1996
Mode: Single-player video game
Developers: Black Ops Entertainment, Point of View
Platforms: Playstation, Sega Saturn
Genres: Shooter Video Game, Simulation Game
Publishers: Virgin Interactive, Virgin Interactive Entertainment (Europe) Ltd.
